results.title: Solvay lead Spanish Primera División with Ivanchuk on board one
results.description: Club Ajedrez Solvay lead the Spanish "Primera División" team championship with a perfect 6/6 match points after three rounds in Linares. Granada SIDN-Cívica-Nazaríes-Trevenque, Gros Xake Taldea and Andreu Paterna share second place on 4/6. With four rounds still to play, the race for the two promotion places to the "División de Honor" remains open in the eight-team, round-robin event. | Photo: Spanish Chess Federation
